conceptZh: 小外星人的飛碟光束和玩具戰士一頭一尾拉著一隻會伸長的橡膠青蛙拔河，青蛙被拉成長長一條後「啵」地彈開，兩人各自跌坐在地，彈飛的綠色橡膠條甩成蛙字，小青蛙則蹦到戰士翻倒的圓盾上呱呱叫。
object: a big round lime-green rubber frog toy that stretches like taffy when pulled, fought over by a small green cartoon alien in a toy flying saucer with a glitchy tractor beam and a chunky toy warrior with a foam sword and round shield
morph: the tug-of-war stretches the rubber frog into one long green elastic band; when it snaps, the band whips apart into green stroke-sticks that spring into place as 蛙 (虫 on the left, 圭 on the right), while the frog itself pops back to its small round shape and bounces onto the warrior's upturned shield
creativeAngle: 全新拔河版：前一版是海盜用望遠鏡找躲貓貓的筆畫、青蛙只在最後跳出，動作偏小。這次把青蛙本身當成拔河的橡膠繩，飛碟光束拉頭、戰士拉腿，拉到最長的那一瞬間「啵」地鬆開，彈開的橡膠條直接甩成蛙字，字形是撞擊的結果而非憑空出現。小外星人的光束「抓錯東西」性格也用上了：開場先吸起荷葉，結尾還把自己的飛碟吸歪，戰士則一揮劍就原地轉圈。青蛙最後在圓盾上鼓著臉頰呱呱叫，正好對上「青蛙」兩字，聽到什麼就看到什麼。
promptEn:
An 8-second bright cartoon clip teaching the Traditional Chinese character 蛙 (frog). Soft pale-cream background, clean flat floor with one small blue puddle, nothing busy behind.

Moment 1 (0–1.5s): A big round lime-green rubber frog toy sits on a lily pad in the center, blinking. A small toy flying saucer zips in from the upper left; inside it a little green cartoon alien with one big eye rubs its hands greedily. Its glowing tractor beam flicks down and lifts the LILY PAD instead of the frog, the alien groans, drops it, and re-aims. As the beam finally grips the frog's head, the voice says 蛙. From the right a chunky toy warrior stomps in, swings his foam sword so hard he spins a full circle, then grabs the frog's back legs with both arms.

Moment 2 (1.5–3.5s): Tug-of-war. The saucer hauls up-left, the warrior leans back right, boots skidding on the floor. The rubber frog stretches like taffy into one long green elastic band across the frame, its eyes going wide and wobbly. The saucer tilts nose-down straining, the alien's eye bulges, the warrior's face turns tomato red and his shield rattles. A frozen half-second at maximum stretch, everything trembling.

Moment 3 (3.5–5s): BOING. The band snaps loose. The saucer rockets backward and bonks the top-left corner with a soft rubbery bump, spinning dizzily; the warrior flies back and lands flat on his bottom, his round shield rolling off and flopping face-up on the floor. The released green band whips apart into stroke-sticks that spring crisply into place at center as 蛙, 虫 on the left and 圭 on the right, every stroke correct and clearly separated. The voice says the second 蛙 exactly as the last strokes click in. The frog itself pops back to small and round and bounces across the floor in two hops.

Moment 4 (5–8s): The finished 蛙 stays perfectly still, centered, filling about 70% of frame height with margins. The little frog lands on the upturned shield like a lily pad, puffs its cheeks huge and gives a big joyful ribbit, body squashing and stretching, as the voice says 青蛙. In the upper corner the dizzy saucer's beam hiccups, grabs the warrior's foam sword, then its own saucer, hoisting itself lopsided while the alien shrugs with a grin; the warrior sits up and applauds. No character touches or covers the strokes.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "蛙、蛙、青蛙" (ㄨㄚ、ㄨㄚ、ㄑㄧㄥ ㄨㄚ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, then stops; no other speech, only soft cartoon stretch and boing sounds, no music louder than the voice. The only on-screen text is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 蛙 in saturated solid deep leaf green on the pale cream background. No vocabulary text, subtitles, watermark, clutter, flashing, real people or realistic humans; bright but not neon, no dark grading.
